parsed.summary: Targets an aspirational EBIT margin in the 16% to 17% range
parsed.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
parsed.quote: Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration.

parsed.summary: Expects one-time transaction expenses of approximately USD 50 million
parsed.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
parsed.quote: Overall, we are expecting one-time expenses to the tune of approximately $50 million spread over three to four quarters.
